results.controlIntent: Use [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms] to: (a) Document proposed changes to the system; (b) Notify [Assignment: organization-defined approval authorities] of proposed changes to the system; and request change approval; (c) Highlight proposed changes to the system that have not been approved or disapproved within [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; (d) Prohibit changes to the system until designated approvals are received; (e) Document all changes to the system; and (f) Notify [Assignment: organization-defined personnel] when approved changes to the system are completed.

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two sources reveals a mixed conformance picture for CM-3(1) automated change control:

**SATISFIED elements (initial v1 deployment):**
- The model registry entry (e37da8d9) shows version 1 was formally registered (2025-11-30T18:00Z) and received an "Approved" status at 2025-12-01T09:00Z — demonstrating a documented approval workflow existed.
- The CreateEndpoint CloudTrail event (5e7a805b) shows the endpoint was deployed at 2025-12-01T11:00Z, which is *after* the registry approval at 09:00Z. This indicates the "prohibit changes until approval is received" requirement (CM-3(1)(d)) was met for the initial deployment.

**NOT SATISFIED elements (hotfix deployment):**
- The UpdateEndpoint CloudTrail event (1c16c2b4) shows a hotfix deployment on 2026-03-15T14:22Z by the same IAM user (data-scientist-jdoe) using a new config ("churn-predictor-v1-hotfix") with **no corresponding model registry entry**. This means:
  - **(a) Documentation of proposed change** — not evidenced (no registry entry for the hotfix).
  - **(b) Notification of approval authorities** — not evidenced.
  - **(d) Prohibition until approval received** — violated; the change was deployed without any registry-tracked approval.
  - **(e) Documentation of all changes** — partially met (CloudTrail captures the API call, but no formal change record exists in the registry).
  - **(f) Notification upon completion** — not evidenced.

**No evidence** was found of automated mechanisms for: highlighting unapproved changes within a defined time period (CM-3(1)(c)), or automated notifications to personnel upon change completion (CM-3(1)(f)), for either deployment event.
gaps: No evidence of automated notification mechanisms (SNS, EventBridge, etc.) alerting approval authorities of proposed changes (CM-3(1)(b)).
No evidence of automated alerting for changes pending approval beyond a defined time window (CM-3(1)(c)).
No evidence of automated completion notifications to designated personnel (CM-3(1)(f)).
No model registry entry or change ticket for the 2026-03-15 hotfix deployment — human attestation needed to determine whether an out-of-band approval process was followed.

No evidence of pipeline enforcement (e.g., SageMaker Pipeline gate, Lambda approval step) that would technically block unapproved deployments — the hotfix bypass suggests such a gate is absent or circumventable.
